title: geonoma pinnatifrons subsp. martinicensis
intro: Geonoma pinnatifrons subsp. martinicensis, commonly known as the Martinique geonoma, is a plant species belonging to the family Arecaceae, native to Martinique and other Caribbean islands. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide several health benefits, including the relief of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of G. pinnatifrons subsp. martinicensis include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help in soothing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
